comment: I don't understand how people don't adore her. She is so sweet and supportive and lets you retake the exam for a higher grade. She also loves what she does and will spend however long you need on the topic. Cog neuro is a hard class because the info is somewhat dense, but she makes to fun and relatable.

Bukach is a really sweet professor, but can come off as unorganized or under prepared. Lectures can be overwhelming with terms and information. Weekly readings to compliment the lecture but overall workload is very little. Lab is mainly group work and review of material covered in class.

It should be noted that I took the "Criminal Brain" class, which was the first year this class had been introduced. It was completely reliant on powerpoint lectures that were extremely disengaging. The work itself isn't extremely difficult, just far too time consuming for a first year seminar course. She never gives you a reason why you should care
I have only had very caring and accommodating professors for the past three years, and taking a class with Bukach opened me to new experiences :( DM me for details

I cannot explain in words the lack of empathy this professor lacks. She is unwilling to accommodate even emergency medical issues approved by the Dean.
I had a really hard semester struggling with depression and the side effects of meds. I also broke my ankle and got covid. she didn't care. (Reach out to me to see the screenshots our emails)

Bukach significantly eased up this semester, the class was realistically difficult and she gave us full credit for weekly assignments if completed. She is very willing to help and expects you to use her office hours. Pretty approachable, will go so far as to offer you food & tea if you come to her office.
does not know what she is talking about should not teach math class .... i did better in calc wtf

She is great teacher with a wealth of well-researched knowledge who truly cares about her students.  She expects a lot, but is very helpful. I like how she challenges people to do their best and does not "give in" to tricks to make the work easier.  I'd take any class she is teaching - even though I am not a psychology major!  Complainers are lazy!
one of the best professors at UR. If you have the chance then take her class you will learn more then you thought possible. Shes very helpful and wants everyone to do well.

Dr. Bukach is AMAZING. She is so friendly, so helpful, and really wants classes to be interesting. She tries so hard to make sure that her students are happy. If you ask for help she is VERY enthusiastic about getting you what you need. There is a lot of work, but you don't notice you're doing it because she makes it interesting.
Very helpful and kind. Genuine interest in her students. She asks a lot out of us, but its not excessive--people just don't like to work. She really prepares you for whats out there
Extremely helpful. She is always willing to talk to students. She expects a high quality of work, but this will teach you more in the long run. I've learned a lot from her.
The class was a little difficult, but she was always willing to help and work with the students on any problems
Always willing to help out and work with the students
she is very hard but also very helpful. she wants all of her students to do well and expects a lot from everyone.

She gives ridiculous amounts of work. She expects way too much from her students and doesn't understand that we don't have PhD's like she does. She's condescending, but at the same time expects us to know everything. Even though I only have her class two days a week, I'm doing hours of work for that class every single day.
Easily the worst professor at UR.  She is terrible.  Never take her.

Extremely condescending and not helpful when you go to see her outside of class. I'm likely getting a B+ due to excessive effort in this class. She likes what she's teaching but she has communication issues with the students. There are four major projects in the 331/332 combo. It requires a lot of time and energy and it's not really worth it.
Unreasonable, has no idea how to run a class.
No Comments
